name: BytePlus Light
tagline: The BytePlus deck in the light look of the official BytePlus PowerPoint master: pale blue gradient backgrounds, the dark wordmark, BytePlus blue accents and the same media-first runtime.
occasion: converting a BytePlus pptx while keeping its look
architecture and solution walkthrough with diagrams
customer / partner briefing in a bright room or on a projector
decks that will also be printed or exported to PDF
density: medium: one claim per slide, proof in diagrams, images and videos

palette.bg_images: assets/img/bg-light-cover.jpg (circles + M icon: cover, part, end) and bg-light-content.jpg (white-to-blue gradient: every other slide), from the BytePlus pptx master
palette.description: light slides like the BytePlus pptx master; near-black text, one BytePlus-blue accent, white cards and plates with a soft blue shadow

typography.style: bold sans headlines with the second half in BytePlus blue (no italics), sans body, uppercase mono chrome; sizes in calc(N * var(--u)) with --u = min(1vw, 1.7778vh)

canvas: fluid 100vw x 100vh slides kept at 16:9 proportions by --u
best_for: BytePlus decks that should match the official light PowerPoint look: pptx conversions, architecture diagrams framed on white plates, product pitches with image and video proof, the About-BytePlus timeline.
avoid_for: Dark-room keynote moods (use byteplus), non-BytePlus brands, Bible/teaching decks.
layouts: layer playground (drag / resize / rotate cut-out layers, move them between two images)
agent explainer (flow bar + points + full-screen demo)
navigation: slide engine (arrows, space, Home/End, wheel, swipe, nav dots) + media runtime (video model, lightbox, tabs, layer playground, N notes, F fullscreen)
source: generated from templates/byteplus by scripts/make_byteplus_light.py; generate new decks with scripts/build_deck.py
